cr.sub.en: Instagram accounts Studio posts for, replies on and reads the numbers of.
cr.sub.zh: Studio 代为发布、回复评论并读取数据的 Instagram 账号。

cr.empty.en: No creator accounts yet. Create one with scripts/creators-import.ts.
cr.empty.zh: 还没有达人账号。用 scripts/creators-import.ts 创建。

cr.sweep.off.en: Automatic posting and replies are off: {why}.
cr.sweep.off.zh: 自动发布和回复已关闭：{why}。

cr.sweep.never.en: Automatic posting and replies are on. No run yet in this server session.
cr.sweep.never.zh: 自动发布和回复已开启。本次运行尚未执行。

cr.sweep.last.en: Last run {at}: {started} posts started, {sent} replies sent, {drafted} drafted, {flagged} flagged.
cr.sweep.last.zh: 上次运行 {at}：开始发布 {started} 条，发送回复 {sent} 条，起草 {drafted} 条，标记 {flagged} 条。

cr.queue.confirmNow.en: This publishes to @{handle} on Instagram now. Continue?
cr.queue.confirmNow.zh: 这会立即发布到 Instagram 的 @{handle}。继续吗？

cr.new.mediaHint.en: Click to add; click again to remove. The number is the order.
cr.new.mediaHint.zh: 点击添加，再点一次移除。数字是顺序。

cr.new.libraryEmpty.en: The library has nothing of this type yet. Add it on the Library tab.
cr.new.libraryEmpty.zh: 素材库里还没有这种类型的素材。到素材库添加。

cr.lib.uploadHint.en: PNG and WebP become high-quality JPEGs (Instagram takes JPEG only). The same file twice is added once.
cr.lib.uploadHint.zh: PNG 和 WebP 会转成高质量 JPEG（Instagram 只收 JPEG）。同一文件只添加一次。

cr.com.checked.en: Read {read} comments, {added} new; {drafted} replies drafted, {flagged} flagged.
cr.com.checked.zh: 读取 {read} 条评论，新增 {added} 条；起草回复 {drafted} 条，标记 {flagged} 条。

cr.com.autoOff.en: Auto-reply is off: drafted replies go out only when someone presses Send now.
cr.com.autoOff.zh: 自动回复已关闭：起草的回复只在有人点“立即发送”时发出。

cr.com.confirmSend.en: This replies publicly on Instagram as @{handle}. Continue?
cr.com.confirmSend.zh: 这会以 @{handle} 在 Instagram 公开回复。继续吗？

cr.com.flagNote.en: Studio never answers this. Reply in the Instagram app if at all.
cr.com.flagNote.zh: Studio 不会回复这条。如需回复，请在 Instagram 应用里处理。

cr.stats.followersInfo.en: Instagram's follower count at the latest daily read. The small number is the change against the read seven days earlier.
cr.stats.followersInfo.zh: 最近一次每日读取时 Instagram 的粉丝数。小字是与七天前读取相比的变化。

cr.stats.reachInfo.en: Accounts that saw any of her posts, summed over the last seven days Instagram reported (account insights, metric reach, one day at a time). Not unique across days.
cr.stats.reachInfo.zh: 最近七个上报日看到她任意帖子的账号数之和（账号洞察 reach，按天）。跨天不去重。

cr.stats.postsInfo.en: Posts Studio published in the last 30 days (the line: the last 14 days). The small number is what is scheduled.
cr.stats.postsInfo.zh: Studio 过去 30 天发布的帖子（折线：最近 14 天）。小字是已排期数量。

cr.stats.repliesInfo.en: Replies Studio sent to comments in the last seven days. The small number is flagged comments waiting for a person.
cr.stats.repliesInfo.zh: Studio 过去七天发出的评论回复。小字是等待人工处理的标记评论。

cr.stats.bestInfo.en: The post with the highest reach at its latest read, among posts from the last 30 days.
cr.stats.bestInfo.zh: 过去 30 天的帖子中，最近一次读取触达最高的一条。

cr.stats.never.en: Not read yet: the daily read runs with the live sweep, or press Read now.
cr.stats.never.zh: 尚未读取：每日读取随在线任务运行，或点“立即读取”。

cr.char.adminOnly.en: Only a staff administrator changes the character and the settings.
cr.char.adminOnly.zh: 只有员工管理员可以修改人设和设置。

cr.failed.en: That did not work. Reload and try again.
cr.failed.zh: 操作失败。请刷新后重试。
